n1.summary: Shows EmptyState with a retry button when stats are missing, otherwise the header, two stat cards and the trip list.

n2.summary: Shows a message and a Retry button that calls onRetry.

n3.summary: Moved to dash/ and now hides trips whose status is DONE.

n4.summary: Pulled out of Dashboard unchanged: the title, the weekly counts and the close button.

n5.summary: Moved to dash/ unchanged: a clickable card with a title and a value.

react.useState.here: open remembers which card was clicked; each click re-renders Dashboard with the new value.

react.callbackProps.here: Dashboard passes onOpen, onRetry and setOpen down; the children call them instead of owning the state.

react.keys.here: Trips are keyed by trip.id, so filtering out DONE trips keeps each row matched to its trip.

fundamental.text: Each onOpen arrow closes over setOpen and its own card name, so a click on Trips sets 'trips' and nothing else.
